sample_unit: FAQ answers (10 Google FAQs and 10 ChatGPT-generated FAQs)

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease) of ChatGPT answers to CRPS patient FAQs
links.effect: ChatGPT answers to Google-generated questions were more difficult to read, Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease 13.6 ± 10.8 (P = 0.017); answers also significantly longer than Google's.
links.quote: ChatGPT's answers to Google-generated questions were more difficult to read based on the Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease Score (13.6 ± 10.8, P = 0.017).

screen.reason: Evaluates readability and comprehensiveness of ChatGPT-generated patient education materials on complex regional pain syndrome compared to Google search, without testing a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
